description: Physical admission of satellite channels for R11. Empty until a channel passes the documented admission; an empty list keeps satellite_supervision false.

example.channel: <instrument>/<platform>:<channel number as written by the token store>

example.passport_sha256: <SHA256 of the radiometric passport recorded by the token store>
example.observation_error_k: <not below NEdT; calibrated by Desroziers diagnostics>

weighting_function.source: <model, version, atmosphere and geometry of the weighting-function computation>
